title: ICPC Team Selection
source_topic: ICPC / The 2016 ACM - Asia Nha Trang Regional Contest
statement: Given 3N students with individual scores, a coach must split them into N teams of three; a team's performance is the median of its three scores and the total is the sum over teams. The task is to report the largest achievable total. Both N and every score are at most 100, over up to twenty datasets.
